finding_key: packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts::no schema validation on the internal clipboard payload, so attacker-controlled block fields (including the now-retained `headinglevel`) become model state and are written into the shared crdt
evidence: Verified clipboard.ts:40-48: deserializeClipboard checks only version===1 and Array.isArray before casting payload.blocks as Block[] with no field validation, and the PR's own test helper confirms WAFFLEDOCS_MIME JSON flows straight into insertBlocks, which copies headingLevel/listKind/etc. onto model blocks. The diff also shows the new unlistedBlockType/keepHeadingLevel paths make a list-item's headingLevel live state that reaches YorkieDocStore.setBlockType and the shared tree attrs, so an injected out-of-range value can persist for collaborators. The reviewer slightly misstates history (headingLevel was already copied unconditionally pre-PR; the PR narrows it), and I could not see the handlePaste flavour-preference lines (omitted region) or line 439's Number() read, hence medium confidence. Real but largely pre-existing hardening gap whose demonstrated impact is corrupted document state, not code execution.
